gen-flavors-gf-sofia-sans-semi-condensed: Whimsical to its core, Flavors gives its diagonals the same heft as its stems and lifts a towering x-height above them. Flavors grabs attention; Sofia Sans Semi Condensed carries the sentences.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-sono: A clear channel runs into every round letter of Autour One, with no hairline-to-stem shift. And Sono spaces its letters generously, so paragraphs move at an easy, unhurried pace.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-stack-sans-notc: Spaghetti-like strokes give Funnel Display its look, each one the same width. Stack Sans Notch then reads like rod stock, its open curves easy to see into and every lowercase word feeling big-bodied.
gen-flavors-gf-pathway-extreme: Twine pressed into a flat surface: that is Flavors, with diagonals as hefty as stems and a towering x-height. What stands out in Pathway Extreme is its big x-height beside stubby ascenders.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-tiktok-sans: Expressive from the first glyph, Autour One leads each round letter in through a clear channel. But TikTok Sans keeps text moving smoothly, its tall lowercase nearly reaching cap height.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-anek-gujarati: Grandstander is all wire-cut swagger, with letters held open. Anek Gujarati settles in beneath it with lowercase that rivals the capitals and a gaping c, all friendly and clean.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Bold from the first stroke, Grandstander keeps its lines a constant width and its letters held open. Anek Gurmukhi backs it up with big counters in every small letter and open-handed curves.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-anek-malayalam: Bent pipe in letter form, that's Grandstander, constant in width. It's built to announce, while Anek Malayalam does the quieter work, keeping caps and lowercase close in height with curve tips left open.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-anek-telugu: Anek Telugu sets a reading rhythm of wide, tall bowls, with rounds left unsealed like an unlatched hook. Grandstander handles the loud part, bent-paperclip strokes with no swelling.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-athiti: Grandstander keeps every line a constant width, letters held open. Athiti follows with a visible gap in each s and a high mean line, a contemporary, approachable partner for those sturdy forms.
